SELECT MIN(co2_emissions/quantity) FROM material_usage JOIN brands ON material_usage.brand_id = brands.brand_id WHERE brands.country = 'Spain';
SELECT MIN(max_speed) as min_speed, MAX(max_speed) as max_speed FROM spacecraft WHERE launch_company = 'SpaceX';
SELECT AVG(recycling_rate) FROM recycling_rates WHERE state = 'California' AND year = 2020;
SELECT SUM(population) FROM wildlife WHERE year = 2020;
SELECT MAX(price) as max_price, MIN(size_sqft) as min_size FROM property WHERE has_inclusive_policy = true;
SELECT industry, SUM(num_employees) as total_employees, union_status FROM employees GROUP BY industry, union_status;
SELECT AVG(ph) FROM saltwater_aquaculture WHERE location = 'North Atlantic';
SELECT AVG(price/quantity) FROM dispensary WHERE name = 'Dispensary X' AND product LIKE '%concentrate%';
SELECT MIN(shipment_weight) FROM shipments WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE port_name = 'Port of Tokyo' AND country = 'Japan') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ship_date) = 2018;
SELECT program, AVG(energy_savings) OVER (PARTITION BY program ORDER BY program ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as moving_average FROM energy_efficiency;
SELECT market_share FROM market_share_2 WHERE hotel_chain = 'Hotel Chain C' AND region = 'South America';
SELECT SUM(Donations.amount) FROM Donations INNER JOIN Donors ON Donations.donor_id = Donors.donor_id WHERE Donors.country = 'Brazil' AND Donations.cause = 'Climate Change Mitigation';
SELECT MIN(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MinPlaytime, MAX(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MaxPlaytime FROM Players WHERE Multiplayer = 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM Funding WHERE program IN ('Women', 'Non-binary') AND gender = 'Female' OR gender = 'Non-binary';
SELECT c.name, SUM(f.hectares) as total_hectares FROM Forests f JOIN Countries c ON f.country = c.code GROUP BY c.name;
SELECT ArtistName, SUM(SalesAmount) as TotalRevenue FROM MusicSales GROUP BY ArtistName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM hotels WHERE country = 'United States' AND ai_services = true;
SELECT MAX(property_price) FROM sustainable_communities;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accidents JOIN vessels ON accidents.vessel_id = vessels.id WHERE vessels.cargo_capacity > 5000;
SELECT name, SUM(budget) FROM programs WHERE participants > 50 GROUP BY name;
SELECT Country, AVG(Consumption) as Avg_Consumption FROM EnergyConsumptionPerCapita WHERE Year = 2021 GROUP BY Country;
SELECT program_id, SUM(impact_score) as total_impact_score FROM programs WHERE program_year = 2019 GROUP BY program_id ORDER BY total_impact_score DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT service, COUNT(*) as total_complaints FROM customer_complaints GROUP BY service;
SELECT AVG(total_spending) FROM gaming_facts WHERE country = 'North America';
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM properties WHERE inclusive_policy = true GROUP BY city;
SELECT p.name, s.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id WHERE s.name IS NULL;
SELECT country, SUM(calories) as total_calories FROM workouts GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_calories DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attendee_age < 12 AND age_distribution_children = TRUE)) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM AgeDistribution WHERE event_name = 'Family Day';
SELECT s.name, AVG(lf.progress) as avg_progress FROM lifelong_learning lf JOIN schools s ON lf.school_id = s.school_id GROUP BY s.name;
SELECT s.supplier_name FROM suppliers s JOIN ingredients i ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id JOIN restaurants r ON i.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id WHERE r.rating = 'Organic';
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) as PlayerCount FROM Players GROUP BY Country ORDER BY PlayerCount DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT project_type, COUNT(*) as num_projects, SUM(budget) as total_budget FROM explainable_ai_projects GROUP BY project_type ORDER BY total_budget DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT event_id, event_location, event_type, num_attendees, AVG(num_attendees) OVER () AS avg_attendees FROM Events WHERE num_attendees > AVG(num_attendees)) AS subquery;
SELECT country, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM Contributors GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_designers WHERE country = 'Africa' AND genre = 'Adventure' AND players > 2000;
SELECT project_name, cost FROM creative_ai_projects ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT state, SUM(length) FROM Highways GROUP BY state;
SELECT p.gender, SUM(c.claim_amount) as total_claim_amount FROM policyholders p JOIN claims c ON p.id = c.policyholder_id GROUP BY p.gender;
